scope: Static review and27plan/source hash-size checks; nothing applied by reviewer.

checks.backup: exclusive byte copy, fsync, reread equality before replace
checks.writing: exclusive temporary file, size check, atomic replace, post-write byte equality, per-surface receipt
checks.dependencies: helper pinned and guarded main has no import-time mutation
checks.scope: eight named existing memory surfaces; additive documentary entry; no kernel/program/gate writes

limitations: Optimistic before/after hash checks are not an atomic cross-process CAS or lock. Apply only under the claimed single-writer scope; concurrent writer between final check and replace can cause lost update.
Multi-surface append is not transactional; on partial failure preserve receipts/backups, reconcile explicitly, do not blindly retry.
Review is technical, not gerência acceptance or authorization to change any other surface.
